title: Match the checkpoint to the visual contract
description: Select a workload and deploy a 4B or 14B single-image or multi-image checkpoint. The comparison exposes curriculum fit, parameter-size pressure, and the paper's four multi-image benchmark scores.
sourceNote: BLINK, QBench, MuirBench, and Mantis-Eval values are from Table 2 of the BLIP-3 paper. Parameter-count pressure is a size proxy, not a latency or cost benchmark.

checkpoints.label: 4B single-image
checkpoints.detail: Lower parameter-size pressure with instruction tuning centered on one image at a time.

checkpoints.label: 4B multi-image
checkpoints.detail: Adds interleaved multi-image instruction tuning while retaining the smaller model size.

checkpoints.label: 14B single-image
checkpoints.detail: Larger language-model capacity without the final multi-image instruction curriculum.

checkpoints.label: 14B multi-image
checkpoints.detail: Combines the larger model with interleaved multi-image instruction tuning.

scenarios.label: Catalog captioning
scenarios.detail: One product image per request, high volume, moderate reasoning, and human review of generated copy.
scenarios.failure: A larger or multi-image checkpoint adds deployment burden without proving better outcomes on the single-image catalog slice.

scenarios.label: Before-and-after inspection
scenarios.detail: Compare four equipment photos in order and identify what changed between visits.
scenarios.failure: A single-image checkpoint may describe each photo but lose cross-image identity, order, or change relationships.

scenarios.label: Multi-figure research QA
scenarios.detail: Reason across plots, diagrams, and captions from several figures where relationships are more important than throughput.
scenarios.failure: The wrong curriculum or insufficient capacity can fragment evidence across figures and weaken cross-image reasoning.

scenarios.label: Single-diagram expert QA
scenarios.detail: Analyze one dense engineering diagram with difficult domain reasoning and a strict review gate.
scenarios.failure: Choosing by parameter count alone is not enough; the dense-diagram slice still needs grounding and OCR evaluation.
